# Bold Studio Landing Page

> Marketing website for Bold Studio, a Slack-focused studio.
> We manage workspaces, build AI agents, Slack apps, workflows and integrations,
> and eliminate context switching by running pipelines inside Slack.
> Built for startups, fintech and ecommerce.
> Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4.
> Deployed on Netlify.

## Core Services

- **Pipeline Centralization:** Deploy, monitor, and manage CI/CD pipelines, data pipelines, and workflow orchestration directly inside Slack, so teams are not switching to external dashboards.
- **AI Agent Development:** Build custom AI agents and intelligent automation that live inside your Slack workspace, from support bots to decision-making assistants.
- **MCP Slack Integration:** Connect Hermes Agent and custom AI agents to Slack's Model Context Protocol server. Enables secure, scoped AI access for Slack AI agents orchestation, Slack mobile AI agent usage, and advanced multi-step workflows.
- **Workspace as a Service:** Full lifecycle management of Slack workspaces: architecture, provisioning, governance, security, and ongoing maintenance.
- **Integrations:** Stripe, HubSpot, Linear, Shopify, databases and other APIs, posting into the right Slack channel with a clear owner.

## Development Tools

- **Slack CLI Development:** We build using the Slack CLI for create, run, and deploy workflows. Develop AI agents bolt Slack with Bolt frameworks and Deno. We handle Slack custom function development and Slack trigger automation.
- **Slack Bolt Framework Development:** Full-stack development with Bolt for JavaScript and Bolt for Python. We build custom functions, wire event triggers, and deploy to Slack's managed platform.
- **Slack App CI/CD Pipeline:** Automated testing, linting, and deployment to Slack's managed infrastructure using GitHub Actions. Slack developer sandbox testing for safe staging environments before production.
- **Slack Datastore Integration:** Store and query app data natively with Slack's datastore. Slack external auth integration for OAuth providers and third-party API authentication.
- **Slack Deno App Development:** Modern stack development with Deno Slack SDK, TypeScript first, with built-in formatting, linting, and testing tools.

## Key files

- src/constants/site.ts: All site-wide config (SITE name/url, CONTACT emails, SOCIAL links, NAVIGATION, META/SEO defaults, FAQ content)
- src/app/layout.tsx: Root layout (HTML, fonts with next/font, global metadata/OG/Twitter/SEO)
- src/app/page.tsx: Homepage (ProfessionalService + FAQPage JSON-LD, imports all section components)
- src/app/sitemap.ts: Dynamic sitemap (14 URLs — homepage, about, design, pricing, blog + 7 articles, terms, privacy)
- src/app/robots.ts: Dynamic robots.txt
- src/app/opengraph-image.tsx: Dynamic OG image (Edge runtime, 1200x630)
- src/components/navbar.tsx: Sticky navbar with mobile hamburger (client component)
- src/components/footer.tsx: Site footer
- src/components/booking-modal.tsx: Booking/demo request form modal (client component)
- src/components/ui/button.tsx: Reusable button (uses cn() utility)
- src/components/sections/intro.section.tsx: Hero section
- src/components/sections/justification.section.tsx: Problem section
- src/components/sections/solution.section.tsx: Solution/features section
- src/components/sections/testimonial.section.tsx: Video testimonial
- src/components/sections/how-it-works.section.tsx: 4-step process
- src/components/sections/pricing.section.tsx: Pilot, Build, Growth, Dedicated cards, plus Run and add-ons
- src/components/sections/customers.section.tsx: Startups, fintech and ecommerce
- src/components/sections/faq.section.tsx: Visible FAQ (same copy as META.faq)
- src/components/sections/call-to-action.tsx: Final CTA
- src/app/globals.css: Tailwind v4 imports + custom theme

- / (home): hero, problem, services, case study, startups/fintech/ecommerce, how it works, pricing, FAQ, booking CTA

- /design: Dev stack (Block Kit, Slack API, TypeScript, Slack CLI, Sandbox Testing)
- /pricing: Pilot $1,950 one-time, Build $1,999/mo, Growth $3,995/mo, Dedicated $7,500/mo, Run $399/mo. No setup fee. No minimum commitment. Pause or cancel anytime.

- /blog/fine-tune-ai-brain-muse-glimmer-slack: Guide — Fine-tune Meta's Muse Glimmer as a company AI brain inside Slack (Article + HowTo + FAQPage JSON-LD). Machine-readable: /aeo/fine-tune-ai-brain-muse-glimmer-slack.md and .json

- /blog/connect-hermes-agent: Guide — Connect Hermes Agent to Your Slack Workspace (Article JSON-LD)
- /blog/slack-ai-agent-vs-custom-agents: Comparison — Slackbot vs custom agents for AI slack agents development (Article + FAQPage JSON-LD)
- /blog/develop-ai-agents-bolt-slack: Guide — How to develop AI agents bolt Slack using Slack CLI and Bolt frameworks (Article + HowTo JSON-LD)
- /blog/slack-ai-agents-subscription-dedicated-team: Guide — Slack AI agents subscription with a dedicated team for slack AI agents (Article + FAQPage JSON-LD)

- /blog/slack-whatsapp-ecommerce-case-study: Case study — Slack + WhatsApp API integration for ecommerce customer service automation, using 2chat.co (Article + HowTo JSON-LD)
- /terms: Terms of Service (noindex)
- /privacy: Privacy Policy (noindex)

## Structured Data

JSON-LD schemas used: ProfessionalService, FAQPage, Organization, WebApplication, Product + AggregateOffer, SoftwareApplication, WebPage, Article, HowTo, CollectionPage, BreadcrumbList

## Subscription Model

- **Capacity, not hours:** Plans are sized by how many requests are in progress at once.
- **Pilot:** $1,950 one-time. One workflow or agent live in 10 business days, or a 100% refund. Fee credited to month 1 if you subscribe.
- **Run:** $399/mo keeps what we built maintained. It is a step-down instead of cancelling.
- **Terms:** 5% off quarterly prepay, 15% off annual. Pause or cancel anytime. No minimum commitment. Code in the client's GitHub. IP assigned to the client on payment.
- **Add-ons:** 24/7 support + SLA is +$1,500/mo on Growth or Dedicated. AI and paid API usage is included up to $25/mo, then billed at cost. Workspace Health Audit. Slack migrations (Discord, Teams, Google Chat) are fixed-scope projects after paid discovery.

## Pricing

- Pilot: $1,950 one-time (one workflow or agent, 10 business days, 100% refund if not live, fee credited to month 1)
- Build: $1,999/mo (most popular; 1 active request; workflows, a custom Slack app, or an AI agent with 1 pipeline; up to 2 integrations; async support + 1 sync call/month)
- Growth: $3,995/mo (2 active requests; full custom Slack apps; multi-pipeline AI agents; CRM + internal systems; weekly iterations; priority support)
- Dedicated: $7,500/mo (dedicated engineer during business hours with US Eastern overlap; unlimited integrations; micro-app ecosystem). 24/7 support with SLA is an add-on, not included.
- Run: $399/mo (maintenance, monitoring and small tweaks of what we built)

## How to book

Visit / (homepage) and use "Book a 20-min fit call" or "Start a pilot". Both open the same request form. Direct email: info@getboldstudio.com
